title: corydalis curvisiliqua subsp. occidentalis
intro: Corydalis curvisiliqua subsp. occidentalis, commonly known as Western Corydalis, is a species of flowering plant in the poppy family. Western Corydalis is known for its traditional use in herbal medicine, where it is valued for its health benefits, including pain relief and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Western Corydalis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids such as berberine, tetrahydropalmatine, and protopine, among others. The combination of its bioactive constituents and traditional use has made Western Corydalis a popular ingredient in herbal remedies for its potential therapeutic benefits.
